summary: Blueprint Inspirations™ Foundation backend — 32/32 pytest tests GREEN. Full CRUD validated for boards, items, activity, comments; tenant isolation strict (cross-tenant 404 on direct GET/PATCH and empty list); permission matrix correct (designer + client can READ/WRITE, no leakage); activity events emitted as specified (board_created/updated, item_added/moved/tagged/item_updated/removed, linked_to_*, comment_added); meta registry returns expected vocabularies; response hydration strips tenant_id and renames *_json columns to clean domain names. Legacy GET /api/inspirations (magazine) NOT shadowed; /api/moodboards and /api/templates smoke OK. One MINOR backend bug surfaced: PATCH /api/inspirations/boards/{id} with a non-existent project_id/lead_id/moodboard_id (UUID does not exist) returns 500 (Supabase FK violation) instead of a clean 400/422.

minor.issue: Posting a syntactically-valid but non-existent project_id (or lead_id / moodboard_id) bubbles the Supabase FK violation up as a 500 Internal Server Error. Should be caught and returned as 400 'Project not found' (or 422). Same risk exists on POST /api/inspirations/boards. Reproduction: PATCH a board with {"project_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"} → 500. Recommend pre-validating linkage IDs against projects/leads/moodboards tables (scoped to tenant) before issuing the UPDATE, or catching APIError/PostgrestAPIError and re-raising HTTPException(400).

action_items: Pre-validate (or wrap-and-translate) FK-linked IDs (project_id / lead_id / moodboard_id) on POST and PATCH /api/inspirations/boards so a stale/bogus UUID returns 400 instead of 500.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/inspirations_boards.py:354 — activity classification uses `patch.keys() == {"position_json", "updated_at"}` to detect a 'moved' event. That works, but note: a combined PATCH that also includes other fields will fall through to 'tagged' (if style_tags present) or 'item_updated'. Current design is fine, just brittle if more auto-mutated fields get added later (e.g., updated_by). Consider an explicit `_classify_item_activity()` helper.

routers/inspirations_boards.py:266-276 — DELETE board: audit_log entry is created, but no _push_activity('board_deleted') row before the cascade. Since the board row is gone, querying activity for it is moot, but if the future timeline page rolls activity at tenant-level rather than per-board, a board_deleted event would be valuable. Minor — VALID_ACTIVITY_TYPES currently doesn't include 'board_deleted' either.

routers/inspirations_boards.py:240-262 — board_updated activity fires with payload={"fields": list(patch.keys())}, which leaks the *_json column names (e.g. 'tags_json') instead of the public 'tags'. Cosmetic but the timeline UI will read those keys; consider mapping back to domain names before emitting.

routers/inspirations_boards.py:331-357 — PATCH item activity classification: when only `position` is sent the resulting patch keys are {'position_json','updated_at'} → 'moved'. Good. But the condition `patch.keys() == {...}` will return False on Python sets being compared to a set literal? Actually patch.keys() is a dict_keys view which compares set-equal — verified working in tests. Just noting subtlety.
routers/inspirations_boards.py:194-221 — POST /boards: no FK validation on project_id/lead_id/moodboard_id before INSERT — same 500 risk as PATCH. Symmetric fix needed.

routers/inspirations_boards.py:54 — router does not declare `prefix="/inspirations"` itself; relies on server.py mounting it BEFORE the legacy inspirations router. Working correctly today (verified GET /api/inspirations still returns legacy magazine shape), but the ordering is load-bearing — worth a comment in server.py at line 54 to prevent regressions if the imports are reordered.

routers/inspirations_boards.py:264 — PATCH returns _hydrate_board(r.data[0] if r.data else None). If r.data is empty (e.g., RLS hides the row), this returns None silently → 200 with null body. Should re-fetch or 404 defensively.

rca of the issue: PATCH/POST /api/inspirations/boards do not pre-validate project_id / lead_id / moodboard_id against existing rows. The Supabase client issues an UPDATE/INSERT that violates the FK constraint defined in migration 011, and the resulting PostgrestAPIError is not caught in inspirations_boards.py — it propagates to FastAPI which converts it to a generic 500. Mitigation: either (a) SELECT-then-validate inside the router (preferred — gives nice 400 with clear message), or (b) wrap the write in try/except PostgrestAPIError and translate code 23503 (foreign_key_violation) → HTTPException(400).
